playback_manager

Classes

PlaybackManager(master[, on_state_change, ...])

Manages audio playback using sounddevice, including state, seeking, and communication with the main GUI thread.
class playback_manager.PlaybackManager(master, on_state_change=None, on_position_update=None)[source]

Bases: object

Manages audio playback using sounddevice, including state, seeking, and communication with the main GUI thread.

__init__(master, on_state_change=None, on_position_update=None)[source]

Initializes the PlaybackManager.

Parameters:

  • master – The root Tkinter window (for scheduling GUI updates).

  • on_state_change (callable) – Callback function to notify the GUI about playback state changes (e.g., ‘playing’, ‘paused’, ‘stopped’).

  • on_position_update (callable) – Callback function to notify the GUI about playback position updates (passes current_frame).

set_audio(audio_data, sample_rate)[source]

Loads new audio data for playback.

toggle_play_pause()[source]

Toggles playback between play and pause.

play()[source]

Starts or resumes audio playback.

pause()[source]

Pauses audio playback.

stop()[source]

Stops audio playback and resets position.

seek(target_frame)[source]

Sets the playback position to the target frame.

cleanup()[source]

Stops audio and cleans up resources.
